method: Frozen ImageNet1K DenseNet121 features add a trainable residual emotion head to unchanged FusDenseNet v4 logits. This is a hybrid project extension, not pure FusDenseNet or exact author reproduction.
backbone_training: Both feature extractors frozen; ONLY new LayerNorm/1024->128->7 residual head trained. No FER-pretrained teacher.
preprocessing: CPU adaptation: grayscale replicated RGB, resize128/center112, official ImageNet mean/std. This differs from the source224-pixel recipe.
selection: Same validation accuracy+disgust recall strict gains, macro/disgustF1 floors; .5accuracy+.3macroF1+.2disgustF1.
test: No test opened; at most one final candidate will be frozen across this and the v5spatial run before one descriptive historically inspected-test evaluation.
disclosure: Added after v5epoch2validation and failed translation screen, before any new test access. Validation repeatedly reused; not preregistered at project start or fresh confirmatory evidence.
